## Optimizing Metalworking Fluid Performance.
* [Learn more about Additin® for Metalworking Fluids][66] [Milling metalworking process. cutting
  end-tooth vertical mill at factory. ]
  
  #### Enhancing Machining Performance
  
  From extreme-pressure additives to friction modifiers, advanced additive technologies help
  metalworking fluids deliver reliable performance under demanding operating conditions.
  
  
  Learn more about Additin® for Metalworking Fluids
* [Learn more about Microbial Control for Metalworking Fluids][67] [Metalworking machine at work.
  Cutting a thread in a workpiece. Cooling lubricant supply. Process of drilling on CNC machines and
  system supply, cutting fluid. The process of drilling metal with water supply.]
  
  #### Maintaining Fluid Stability for Longer
  
  Microbial contamination can compromise fluid performance, increase maintenance requirements, and
  shorten sump life. LANXESS helps manufacturers maintain stable metalworking fluids through
  effective microbial control solutions.
  Learn more about Microbial Control for Metalworking Fluids
* [Learn more about Corrosion Protection Solutions][68] [Lubricant runs over roller bearings]
  
  #### Protecting Metal Surfaces from Corrosion
  
  Effective corrosion protection is essential for preserving workpiece quality and ensuring process
  reliability. LANXESS offers corrosion inhibitor technologies that help protect metal surfaces
  throughout manufacturing, storage, and downstream processing.
  Learn more about Corrosion Protection Solutions

## Optimizing Metalworking Fluid Performance.
* [Learn more about Additin® for Metalworking Fluids][66] [Milling metalworking process. cutting
  end-tooth vertical mill at factory. ]
  
  #### Enhancing Machining Performance
  
  From extreme-pressure additives to friction modifiers, advanced additive technologies help
  metalworking fluids deliver reliable performance under demanding operating conditions.
  
  
  Learn more about Additin® for Metalworking Fluids
* [Learn more about Microbial Control for Metalworking Fluids][67] [Metalworking machine at work.
  Cutting a thread in a workpiece. Cooling lubricant supply. Process of drilling on CNC machines and
  system supply, cutting fluid. The process of drilling metal with water supply.]
  
  #### Maintaining Fluid Stability for Longer
  
  Microbial contamination can compromise fluid performance, increase maintenance requirements, and
  shorten sump life. LANXESS helps manufacturers maintain stable metalworking fluids through
  effective microbial control solutions.
  Learn more about Microbial Control for Metalworking Fluids
* [Learn more about Corrosion Protection Solutions][68] [Lubricant runs over roller bearings]
  
  #### Protecting Metal Surfaces from Corrosion
  
  Effective corrosion protection is essential for preserving workpiece quality and ensuring process
  reliability. LANXESS offers corrosion inhibitor technologies that help protect metal surfaces
  throughout manufacturing, storage, and downstream processing.
  Learn more about Corrosion Protection Solutions

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

[Feather on the Heart, a Time Threads Novel by Richard Grossman]

# Feather on the Heart

## A Time Threads Novel

Angela is six when a jaguar stalks into her dreams.

Within weeks, the bright, laughing child her parents knew is retreating into a silence no doctor can
explain. She stops eating. She withdraws from the world. Every system her father, David Colburn, has
trusted begins to fail, and time is running out.

After his friend dies with Angela’s name and Peru on his lips, confirming the impossible dreams and
visions David had tried to dismiss, David travels to the Amazon, where healers and ceremonies lead
him toward a truth larger than illness. Angela’s suffering may be connected to an ancient wound
carried through families, bodies, and generations, a wound that began long before either of them was
born.

## Latest Allegheny Front Episodes

## [ Episode for July 24, 2026 ][114]

[The Allegheny Front][115]·July 24, 2026
U.S. Steel is investing big money to modernize a mill in the Pittsburgh area. Some are worried about
continued air pollution from the plant, while others in the area are excited about its economic
impact. The data power of AI could help weather forecasters with some of their trickiest work, like
tornadoes. A new book looks at the complexities of reintroducing large wildlife species like wolves
and bison back to their original habitats. Pennsylvania has renewed its Solar for Schools program
for a third time. Nonprofit environmental groups are seeking crowdfunding support for their legal
challenge to a massive data center project in Indiana County. Our travel guide provides a glimpse of
a rare bog habitat in the Laurel Highlands.
[Full Episode][116]

## [ Episode for July 17, 2026 ][117]

[The Allegheny Front][118]·July 17, 2026
There's a movement to slow down data center development in Pennsylvania, but state lawmakers weren't
ready to repeal a key tax exemption. People who live near a gas processing facility in rural
Pennsylvania are against its plans to expand. Operations have been stopped at four injection wells
for fracking wastewater in southeastern Ohio, at the request of state regulators. Forests in
Allegheny and Fayette Counties are also now part of the Old-Growth Forest Network. A new book
explores the beauty of Pennsylvania's natural wonders.
[Full Episode][119]
[ [A woman with short white hair and a yellow dog pose in the grass next to a river] ][120]

## [ Episode for July 10, 2026 ][121]

[The Allegheny Front][122]·July 10, 2026
How a Bedford County community benefitted when two dams were removed. A court rules in favor of a
stricter ambient air pollution standard to protect public health. Republican gubernatorial candidate
Stacy Garrity was in Western Pennsylvania to discuss data centers and criticize Governor Josh
Shapiro. An artist provides tips for finding colorful beach glass on your next trip to Lake Erie.
Pennsylvania’s elk country is featured on the season premiere of  Discovery Channel show “RV There
Yet?.” A week-long camp provides community, support and fun for young campers with brain injuries.
[Full Episode][123]

## [ Episode for July 17, 2026 ][117]

[The Allegheny Front][118]·July 17, 2026
There's a movement to slow down data center development in Pennsylvania, but state lawmakers weren't
ready to repeal a key tax exemption. People who live near a gas processing facility in rural
Pennsylvania are against its plans to expand. Operations have been stopped at four injection wells
for fracking wastewater in southeastern Ohio, at the request of state regulators. Forests in
Allegheny and Fayette Counties are also now part of the Old-Growth Forest Network. A new book
explores the beauty of Pennsylvania's natural wonders.

[The Allegheny Front][122]·July 10, 2026
How a Bedford County community benefitted when two dams were removed. A court rules in favor of a
stricter ambient air pollution standard to protect public health. Republican gubernatorial candidate
Stacy Garrity was in Western Pennsylvania to discuss data centers and criticize Governor Josh
Shapiro. An artist provides tips for finding colorful beach glass on your next trip to Lake Erie.
Pennsylvania’s elk country is featured on the season premiere of  Discovery Channel show “RV There
Yet?.” A week-long camp provides community, support and fun for young campers with brain injuries.

self-assembled nanosphere structures used in photonics, sensing, coatings, drug delivery, and
nanosphere lithography. It concludes that multimodal imaging, standardized datasets, and
data-efficient machine learning could improve quantitative inspection and feedback-guided assembly.

[[Application introduction of Paints]][208]
[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

[more][234]
[[Pigment for textile printing]][235]
[Introduction of applications: Textiles][236]

Textile printing technology is based on a variety of ink resins as the carrier, composed of effect
pigments or dyes and related additives, with good adhesion. By different printing methods, words and
drawings are printed on textile fabrics.

های****‌ ****غذایی****" **می پردازد. این نشریه در بررسی و انتشار مقالات علمی از اصول و معیارهای کمیته
اخلاق نشر (**[COPE][52]**) پیروی می نماید. مقالات انگلیسی و فارسی ارسالی، برای اثبات اصالت علمی، حسب
مورد با نرم افزارهای مشابهت یاب iThenticate و همانندجو بررسی گردیده و سپس توسط داوران با تخصص مرتبط،
ارزیابی می شوند.  **این نشریه دربرگیرنده مقالات پژوهشی و مروری به دو زبان انگلیسی و فارسی است.
****براساس ارزیابی کمیسیون نشریات**** ****علمی وزارت عتف در سال ۱۴۰۴، این نشریه**** رتبه "[بین
المللی][53]" را کسب نموده ****و در پایگاه استنادی علوم جهان اسلام**** ****(****ISC:**** 1403, 2024)
 ****شاخص آی اس سی 0.021 و رتبه**** ****Q****4 دارد****.**

**اطلاعیه****: این نشریه علاوه بر ****انتشار مقالات انگلیسی، حداکثر دو شماره در سال به مقالات فارسی
اختصاص می دهد****.  بر این اساس، ****نویسندگان محترم می****‌****توانند نسبت به ارسال مقاله به زبان
فارسی نیز اقدام نمایند****.**

**نمایه‌ شده در پایگاه استنادی SCOPUS **

**نام خلاصه به انگلیسی****: .****Innov. Food Technol****  **

های****‌ ****غذایی****" **می پردازد. این نشریه در بررسی و انتشار مقالات علمی از اصول و معیارهای کمیته
اخلاق نشر (**[COPE][52]**) پیروی می نماید. مقالات انگلیسی و فارسی ارسالی، برای اثبات اصالت علمی، حسب
مورد با نرم افزارهای مشابهت یاب iThenticate و همانندجو بررسی گردیده و سپس توسط داوران با تخصص مرتبط،
ارزیابی می شوند.  **این نشریه دربرگیرنده مقالات پژوهشی و مروری به دو زبان انگلیسی و فارسی است.
****براساس ارزیابی کمیسیون نشریات**** ****علمی وزارت عتف در سال ۱۴۰۴، این نشریه**** رتبه "[بین
المللی][53]" را کسب نموده ****و در پایگاه استنادی علوم جهان اسلام**** ****(****ISC:**** 1403, 2024)
 ****شاخص آی اس سی 0.021 و رتبه**** ****Q****4 دارد****.**

**اطلاعیه****: این نشریه علاوه بر ****انتشار مقالات انگلیسی، حداکثر دو شماره در سال به مقالات فارسی
اختصاص می دهد****.  بر این اساس، ****نویسندگان محترم می****‌****توانند نسبت به ارسال مقاله به زبان
فارسی نیز اقدام نمایند****.**

**نشریه بین المللی فناوری****‌****های جدید در صنعت غذا**، فصلنامه ای با دسترسی باز (به متن مقالات) است
که توسط [**ﺳﺎزﻣﺎن ﭘﮋوهشهای ﻋﻠﻤﯽ و ﺻﻨﻌﺘﯽ اﯾﺮان** ][51]منـتشر می‌شود. این نشریه از سیاست داوری تخصصی یک
سوناشناس در بررسی مقالات استفاده نموده و به مباحث نوپدید در زمینه "**علوم و فناوری
های****‌ ****غذایی****" **می پردازد. این نشریه در بررسی و انتشار مقالات علمی از اصول و معیارهای کمیته
اخلاق نشر (**[COPE][52]**) پیروی می نماید. مقالات انگلیسی و فارسی ارسالی، برای اثبات اصالت علمی، حسب
مورد با نرم افزارهای مشابهت یاب iThenticate و همانندجو بررسی گردیده و سپس توسط داوران با تخصص مرتبط،
ارزیابی می شوند.  **این نشریه دربرگیرنده مقالات پژوهشی و مروری به دو زبان انگلیسی و فارسی است.
****براساس ارزیابی کمیسیون نشریات**** ****علمی وزارت عتف در سال ۱۴۰۴، این نشریه**** رتبه "[بین
المللی][53]" را کسب نموده ****و در پایگاه استنادی علوم جهان اسلام**** ****(****ISC:**** 1403, 2024)
 ****شاخص آی اس سی 0.021 و رتبه**** ****Q****4 دارد****.**

**اطلاعیه****: این نشریه علاوه بر ****انتشار مقالات انگلیسی، حداکثر دو شماره در سال به مقالات فارسی
اختصاص می دهد****.  بر این اساس، ****نویسندگان محترم می****‌****توانند نسبت به ارسال مقاله به زبان
فارسی نیز اقدام نمایند****.**

**نمایه‌ شده در پایگاه استنادی SCOPUS **

**نام خلاصه به انگلیسی****: .****Innov. Food Technol****  **

**توجه: این نشریه برای ارسال، داوری، انتشار و دسترسی به مقالات هزینه‌ای دریافت نمی‌نماید و پرداخت هزینه
های یادشده بر عهده سازمان پژوهش‌های علمی و صنعتی ایران است.  **

# della diagnostica molecolare

[CONTATTACI][18]

POLO BIOTECNOLOGICO
MOLECOLARE

Lipinutragen è la prima azienda italiana, nata dalla conoscenza CNR, che ha sviluppato e portato sul
mercato un **approccio innovativo di medicina molecolare: la nutri-lipidomica**.

Un modello integrato che unisce **diagnostica**, **nutraceutica** e **nutrizione**, offrendo
soluzioni personalizzate ad alto valore scientifico.

## DIAGNOSTICA MOLECOLARE 
## AVANZATA

nel nostro Laboratorio Medico, autorizzato ASL e accreditato ISO 15189:2024.
Attraverso l’analisi del **profilo molecolare della membrana cellulare**, realizziamo **screening
cellulari** che consentono di valutare come **dieta, metabolismo e stile di vita** influenzino i
processi biologici e il benessere sistemico.

## TECNOLOGIA ROBOTICA
## AD ALTO RENDIMENTO
## PER LA SELEZIONE E LA LAVORAZIONE
## DEL GLOBULO ROSSO

LNG-R1 è una tecnologia di robotica ad alto rendimento, **unica al mondo**, sviluppata per la
selezione dell’eritrocita maturo da campione di sangue in EDTA.
La **tecnologia proprietaria Lipinutragen** è parte integrante del **metodo analitico MEM_LIP1
accreditato**, a garanzia di elevati standard di precisione e riproducibilità.

## [NUTRACEUTICA][19]
## AD ALTA BIODISPONIBILITÀ

Formulazioni sviluppate a partire dallo studio dei profili lipidomici e del loro significato
molecolare per la salute umana, basate sul modello **membrane lipid therapy**.
Le formule, realizzate con **materie prime di elevata qualità** e **fattori nutrizionali bilanciati
e mirati alle membrane cellulari**, favoriscono una maggiore biodisponibilità degli attivi.

## CONSULENZA & FORMAZIONE
## SCIENTIFICO-MOLECOLARE

Attività di alta formazione scientifica dedicate ai professionisti sanitari, integrate con **ricerca
e sviluppo**, pubblicazioni scientifiche, consulenze personalizzate e partecipazione a **progetti di
ricerca e studi clinici**, con l’obiettivo di favorire il progresso scientifico e l’innovazione in
ambito sanitario.

[CONTATTACI][18]

POLO BIOTECNOLOGICO
MOLECOLARE

Lipinutragen è la prima azienda italiana, nata dalla conoscenza CNR, che ha sviluppato e portato sul
mercato un **approccio innovativo di medicina molecolare: la nutri-lipidomica**.

Un modello integrato che unisce **diagnostica**, **nutraceutica** e **nutrizione**, offrendo
soluzioni personalizzate ad alto valore scientifico.

## DIAGNOSTICA MOLECOLARE 
## AVANZATA

nel nostro Laboratorio Medico, autorizzato ASL e accreditato ISO 15189:2024.
Attraverso l’analisi del **profilo molecolare della membrana cellulare**, realizziamo **screening
cellulari** che consentono di valutare come **dieta, metabolismo e stile di vita** influenzino i
processi biologici e il benessere sistemico.

## TECNOLOGIA ROBOTICA
## AD ALTO RENDIMENTO
## PER LA SELEZIONE E LA LAVORAZIONE
## DEL GLOBULO ROSSO

LNG-R1 è una tecnologia di robotica ad alto rendimento, **unica al mondo**, sviluppata per la
selezione dell’eritrocita maturo da campione di sangue in EDTA.
La **tecnologia proprietaria Lipinutragen** è parte integrante del **metodo analitico MEM_LIP1
accreditato**, a garanzia di elevati standard di precisione e riproducibilità.

## [NUTRACEUTICA][19]
## AD ALTA BIODISPONIBILITÀ

Formulazioni sviluppate a partire dallo studio dei profili lipidomici e del loro significato
molecolare per la salute umana, basate sul modello **membrane lipid therapy**.
Le formule, realizzate con **materie prime di elevata qualità** e **fattori nutrizionali bilanciati
e mirati alle membrane cellulari**, favoriscono una maggiore biodisponibilità degli attivi.

## CONSULENZA & FORMAZIONE
## SCIENTIFICO-MOLECOLARE

Attività di alta formazione scientifica dedicate ai professionisti sanitari, integrate con **ricerca
e sviluppo**, pubblicazioni scientifiche, consulenze personalizzate e partecipazione a **progetti di
ricerca e studi clinici**, con l’obiettivo di favorire il progresso scientifico e l’innovazione in
ambito sanitario.

The method of solvent extraction uses a separation solvent, which is generally non-volatile has a
high boiling point and is miscible with the mixture, but doesn’t form an isotropic mixture as a
medium to extract essential active elements from spices.

Supercritical fluid extraction is an efficient separation method of active ingredients from plant

CO2.

### FAQs


#### What is the best natural source of vitamin E?

Vegetable oils like sunflower and soy as well as rapeseed are excellent sources of natural vitamin
E. This is because they contain high levels of d-alpha tocopherol.

#### How to check if vitamin E is natural or synthetic?

You should look at the label for the 'd-' prefix for natural vitamin E. Note that the synthetic
versions use the 'dl' prefix.

#### What certifications do you hold?

Matrix Life Science holds several international certifications, including ISO 22000, KOSHER, HALAL,
and FSSC 22000.

#### Is your Natural Vitamin E Non-GMO and Organic certified?

Our ingredients come from 100% non-GMO sources. We offer organic certified options to meet your
specific clean label requirements.

#### Does Matrix Life Science offer both Oil and Powder forms of Vitamin E?

We offer oil as well as powder formats to ensure the ingredients work perfectly in your products.

#### Can Matrix Life Science handle bulk supply for global manufacturers?

Our massive 80,000-square-meter facility allows us to manage bulk orders easily for the largest
global manufacturers.

####  Why is Matrix Life Science considered one of the top Naturall-E producers?

Matrix Life Science is a renowned brand, known as a trusted Naturall-E manufacturer, producing in
India with global presence. Our core expertise lies in the extraction of plant based Natural
Tocopherols (Vitamin E) sourced from 100% Non-GMO Soy, Sunflower, and Rapeseed. Our technologically
advanced manufacturing plant is spread across more than 80, 000 sq. meters and subsidiaries in USA,
Europe, and South America. Our clientele bases are the global industries of food, dietary
supplement, animal nutrition. pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics.

#### MedWin Publishers

Medwin is your gateway to a world of scientific and medical insights, striving to make research
accessible to everyone. We are a global, open-access publisher that publishes articles from
researchers worldwide, emphasizing the latest discoveries in various scientific fields. Our
commitment is to share significant works, including case studies and reviews, and create a strong
platform for researchers and readers globally. Medwin aims to contribute to the global intellectual
landscape by providing profound insights into the latest advancements in scientific research. Our
mission is simple: illuminate the latest findings and create a space where researchers from every
corner of the globe can connect and share ideas.

#### About Us

At Medwin, we're on a mission to make science and medicine understandable and available to all. We
publish original articles that showcase the latest discoveries in a variety of fields. Our goal is
to create a platform for researchers worldwide, transcending borders to share knowledge. We're not
just a publisher; we're a bridge connecting research from every part of the world. Our aim is to
bring the best research to light and share it with the global community.

#### Vision

We dream of being a catalyst for scientific knowledge across all fields. Medwin is a team that
believes in unity, working together to simplify communication and optimize research. We're here to
bring top-notch research to the forefront, covering advanced topics in science and engineering
around the world.

#### Aim & Scope

Medwin's main goal is to cover the latest in scientific progress. We want to contribute to knowledge
by promoting quality research. Our mission is to publish excellent, peer-reviewed work in all
emerging fields of science. We're committed to exploring daily research updates, strengthening
scientific knowledge, contributing to research progress, and providing a high-quality online
platform for original research.

#### Objectives
* **Explore Daily Research:** Medwin is dedicated to keeping up with daily developments in the
  scientific field, keeping you informed about the latest breakthroughs.
* **Strengthen Scientific Knowledge:** We aim to make science understandable and exciting for
  everyone, building a community passionate about research.
* **Contribute to Scientific Progress:** Medwin actively contributes to research progress by
  providing a platform for groundbreaking findings.
* **Provide a High-Quality Platform:** Our commitment to quality extends to providing a robust
  online platform for original research, ensuring the knowledge we share is top-notch.

#### Publication Model

Scholarly publishing, regardless of the medium, entails significant expenditures beyond mere content
creation. Publishers contribute value through a range of essential services, including the
production of documents across various formats, editorial and design work, marketing, and the
facilitation of connections between readers and authors. Each of these activities incurs costs.
Consequently, even non-profit publishers must not only recoup these expenses but also generate a
financial reserve to sustain their operations.

In response to the evolving landscape of scientific publishing, which seeks to enhance the
readership, accessibility, and impact of scholarly research, numerous journals are transitioning
from the traditional subscription-based model to an Open Access (OA) paradigm. Within the gold OA
framework, articles are made freely accessible online upon publication, eliminating paywalls.
Instead, the financial responsibility for publication shifts to the authors’ institutions or funding
organizations, which cover the Article Processing Charge (APC) once the manuscript is accepted.

Niran Bio Tech is a global supplier of food ingredients and additives, providing functional
ingredient solutions for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

[ About us ][65]

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

[ Locations ][66]
Image
[Purple automotive coating]

## What we do

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.
[
Image
[back 3/4 view of a white car with a sunset in the background] ][67]

### Automotive

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.
[Learn more][68]
[
Image
[airplane flying view from inside window of aircraft, flying above the clouds during sunset] ][69]

### Aerospace

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image
[motorcycles parked in row in various colors] ][73]

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.
[Learn more][74]
Image
[White]

## What sets us apart

From the world's most advanced color expertise to award-winning sustainable innovation, these are
some of the capabilities that make us a partner unlike any other.

[
Image
[Refinity app on tablet] ][75]

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image
[Tesseract blue] ][77]

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image
[Automotive color display] ][79]

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.
[Our color expertise][80]
[
Image
[R-M expert] ][81]

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.
[Meet our brands][82]

## Run open-source AI, privately.

We run open-source AI models for you in private, secure datacenters. We never train on your data,
and we never store API prompts or completions.

[Read our GDPR-compliant privacy policy →][3]

## Broad support.

We run models from any supported open-source LLM architecture, including:
* Kimi K2.7 Code
* GLM 5.2
* MiniMax M3
* Qwen3.6 27B

[And many more][4]. If vLLM supports it, we do too.

## Simple pricing.

Subscribe for $30/month, and use models in our app — or in any of your favorite OpenAI-compatible
tools, like [Roo][5], [Cline][6], [Octofriend][7], and more.

Or use standard usage-based pricing and never pay for anything you don't use.

[See pricing →][8]

## Verifiable.

We built[Synbad][9], an open-source evaluation suite sourced from critical bugs encountered by
coding agents like Claude Code, Crush, OpenCode, and more.

industry requirements. Without sacrificing flavor or quality, our TBHQ is expertly blended to

regulatory standards. It is very helpful in stabilizing processed foods, edible oils, and fats by
postponing rancidity and extending their freshness and quality.

### Top TBHQ Manufacturer, Supplier and Exporter in India

You might be looking for the best quality of **TBHQ** that is **tert-butylhydroquinone** which is a
synthetic aromatic organic compound which is a type of phenol. TBHQ is commonly known as antioxidant
that prevents fat oxidation. It is an antioxidant which is generally derived food products and in
fats or oils. Even this is also added to foods as an antioxidant, and it is also produced in the
body as the common metabolite of the two BHA isomers. **Tert-Butylhydroquinone (TBHQ)** is a food
additive and a lipid-antioxidant. It is accessible in a white or whitish-colored crystalline fine
powder. Recently, TBHQ has been found to provide antibacterial activity.

Bromine Compounds, Fine Chemicals, Intermediates, Bulk Drugs, Phase Transfer and Catalysts are also
very popular in the global as well as domestic market. We keep up with the changing trends and
requirements of the market to offer the best.

### TBHQ - Tert- Butylhydroquinone

**TBHQ (Tert Butyl Hydroquinone)** is highly used as anti-oxidant especially for unsaturated
vegetable oils and severable edible animal fats. It prevents any sort of Rancidification i.e.
discoloration, change flavor or odor of food in which it is added. It is synthetic and is also
incorporated due to its effectiveness in polyunsaturated oils, nuts, inedible animal fats, butterfat
and packaged fried foods in addition to foods packaging substances such as Glassine as well as
Paraffin wax. It is well-known in the food industry for its potential to increase the shelf life of
the food products.

## Unwavering dedication. For our customers.

Our commitment to excellence directly impacts your success. We pride ourselves on delivering
unparalleled solutions and support that empower your business to thrive.

### Standby Power Systems

Given the inherent instability of power systems and grids, a rapidly growing business recognized the
necessity for expansion across various key regions. UNIS promptly extended its services into three
major markets, allowing this formidable megawatt industry leader to concentrate on its core
manufacturing operations.

### Top 250 Household Goods MFG

A major household appliances and kitchenware manufacturer experienced such rapid growth that they
found it challenging to keep pace with their increasing demands. Turning to UNIS for a solution,
they required an additional 600,000 square feet of distribution space. Today, UNIS efficiently
fulfills orders for their largest big box clients, ensuring smooth operations for this thriving
business.

[Unwavering dedication. For our customers.]

## Supply chain management that fits your business

Partnering with us means more than just a business relationship. It's an opportunity to unlock a
world of value-added services that will enhance your operations and elevate your success.


### E-commerce

Has your business always been or is transforming to a larger percentage of orders going B2C? Our
proprietary WMS makes sure your order fulfillment is done same day and right every time.


### B2B

Do compliance issues and fines keep you awake at night? We make sure that the issues that flow
downhill to supply chain are resolved so orders get out the door on-time and right every time.

We are committed to providing transparent and efficient shipping services. Our performance metrics
